desc:
🔔 Will the question survive, or will you? Ring the Golden Bell!
🇰🇷 All questions and the host's voice are in Korean.

🔔 GOLDEN BELL MODE (up to 50 players)
• Hear the question, write your answer on a whiteboard in 15 seconds
• One wrong answer and you're out! Survive to the 20th Golden Bell question
• Get it right and ring the Golden Bell yourself

🏆 TRIVIA KING SCORE BATTLE
• No elimination: faster answers score more
• Wrong? Try again! The last question counts double
• The top 3 take the podium

📚 11,000+ QUESTIONS
Science, history, geography, arts, sports and more, getting harder as you go. Questions you've heard rarely repeat.

⭐ LEVELS · COINS · NAME TAGS
• Earn XP and coins every game
• Your level shows above your head
• Buy name tags with coins or unlock special ones like "Golden Bell Winner"

🏫 EXPLORE THE SCHOOL
A 10-floor parkour tower, basketball and a TOP 100 Hall of Fame!

👍 Like and favorite if you had fun!
